research_note.body:
The StarCoder pilot plus adaptive refinement are complete and analyzed. All 20 distinct artifacts have matching frozen fingerprints and unique finite endpoint metrics; Fieldbook contains their checkpoints, eval artifacts and measurements. There are 19 proxy runs and one corrected target endpoint, with one shared web-only proxy and nine historical target points on the ten-coordinate grid.

Unmatched selects p=1 (target BPB 0.819869, regret 0.031826); matched selects p=0.2 (BPB 0.851813, regret 0.063770); target selects p=0.7 (BPB 0.788043). Matching raises observed grid regret by 0.031944 BPB. The independent raw-data calculation agrees exactly, and both plots were visually checked. The original pilot and release-recorded hashes are unchanged. Refinement was adaptive, uses one fixed subset/seed and mixes historical/new target runtimes; no significance or independent-confirmation claim is made.

Report and CC handoff: .agents/projects/starcoder_epoch_matching/refinement/results/RESULTS.md. Primary measurements, curve CSV/JSON, raw/excess plots, descriptive diagnostics and independent verification are adjacent or linked. The paper outline records the unfavorable completed result; manuscript sources and figures remain unchanged. Recommendation: retain this as a limitation case and consider a separately specified subset-sensitivity diagnostic. No new job was released; full 26-point and replicated stages remain unsubmitted. The earlier partial-coverage warning is superseded by completed coverage and retained as an archived validation.
research_note.title: Adaptive refinement moves matched optimum to p=0.2 and increases target regret

experiment.description: Review-stage three-curve experiment: reuse 25 C40 target measurements, correct the target p=1 parent-pool mismatch, compare matched and unmatched 278M-token proxies on one frozen parent corpus. No training submitted.
